create_RetrievalVis: create a RetrievalVis instance to set up an HTML webpage directory for visualizing retrieval results
visualize_ranking: call visualize_ranking to generate an HTML page showing top-k video retrieval rankings for a given epoch
display_current_results: call display_current_results to render rankings with ground truth captions and similarity scores into an HTML report
mkdirs: call mkdirs to create multiple directories at once if they do not already exist
mkdir: call mkdir to create a single directory if it does not already exist
